linkedIn.headline: Founder Black Girls CODE | Founder & CEO Black Innovation Lab and Ascend Ventures | Investor | Author of Ascending | Systems Architect Exploring Power, Innovation & Cultural Transformation
linkedIn.about:
🧩 Coined "Black Girlboss Paradox" — a framework exploring the intersection of race, gender, leadership, and power.
 
I build systems, stories, and platforms that expand who gets to shape the future. My work sits at the intersection of technology, equity, cultural power, and transformation.
 
As the founder of Black Girls CODE, I built one of the most influential STEM movements of the last decade, introducing more than 100,000 girls of color to coding, creativity, and community. Today, through Black Innovation Lab by Ascend Ventures, I’m building a venture ecosystem designed to support visionary founders creating solutions that shape a more equitable and expansive future.

I’m also the founder of Roots & Resilience Studio, home to Inner Garden: Stories of Healing, Land & Legacy and the Roots & Resilience Substack, where I explore Black women's leadership journeys through their connection to land, memory, and narrative.
 
I’ve been honored by the White House and the Smithsonian for my contributions to technology and social impact. My current work focuses on building frameworks and platforms that center innovation, sustainability, ownership, and the leadership of Black women.
 
Across my work, I explore how power operates and how new systems can be built with equity, imagination, and accountability at the center through investing, strategic advising, ecosystem building, storytelling, and public speaking.
 
I’m especially passionate about supporting founders, executives, and emerging leaders, particularly Black women navigating systems not originally designed for us to thrive.
 
If you’re building transformative systems, investing in inclusive innovation, or reimagining leadership and cultural power, let’s connect.

experiences.title: Host & Creator — Inner Garden Podcast: Stories of Healing, Land & Legacy
experiences.description: Narrative podcast exploring how women of color cultivate ancestral wisdom, reconnect with the land, and use the garden as a site of personal and communal healing. Produced by the Roots & Resilience Studio, the series blends reflective storytelling, soft soundscapes, and intimate interviews to center themes of memory, leadership, and liberation; rooted in soil and spirit.
